title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-29
lineage: SBD MR (7" reel @7.5 ips) > DAT > Sony ES 60 > optical > Pioneer PDR555 > CDR > EAC (secure) > CE2K > CD Wave > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture (a bit muddy with hiss) that lets the show’s fire shine – standout Hard to Handle, Mason's Children and a killer Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is a fairly complete sound‑board tape with some room ambience, modest muddiness and hiss, but it remains listenable. Musically the concert is praised for its high energy, superb banter and memorable performances of Easy Wind, Hard to Handle, Mason’s Children, Black Peter (called the best of the year) and a spontaneous St. Stephen.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.5/5; comments are overwhelmingly positive about the performance with only minor recording flaws, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Somewhat muddy with a little hiss and noticeable room ambience that adds presence; otherwise clear enough for an enjoyable listen.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energy builds toward New Year's, banter is highlighted as priceless, and the set flows with strong jams and memorable transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is described as dirty, raunchy, deep and hard‑pushing – a ‘violent’ but satisfying feel.
